plan.notes: Term-by-term sequence transcribed from the official Ashland University 'Forensic Biology Concentration (Biology B.S.) — Comprehensive, no minor required — 2026 FOUR YEAR CURRICULUM GUIDE' (Department of Biology/Toxicology; 'SUGGESTED – Four Year Rotation'; reviewed 6/24/2026). Variable-credit slots (MATH 3-5; Forensic Bio electives 3-4) are seeded at the base credit per collection rules, with the guide's ranges documented in choice_notes; at base credits the plan sums to exactly 120 ('must have at least 120 credits to graduate'). Guide footnotes preserved: '*Both Math 205 and 206 are needed to take Phys 205-206. Math courses can be taken the second year.' / 'See catalog for choice of Forensic Biology electives.' / 'Students planning to attend a graduate or professional school should take a full year of physics, although not required for a major in biology.' The Year 2 Fall MATH slot is conditional ('Math 201 or 205* or Institutional Requirement (Core 8)') — take math there only if not taken in Year 1. Prereqs are not stated on the 4-year guide and are therefore omitted. tccns mirrors the local course code (non-Texas school). transfer_confidence is 'core_only'.
